Home / Services / Luxury Villa Construction

Building a villa is usually the biggest project a family takes on. The usual way, with a separate architect, contractor and interior designer, often means three sets of drawings, three budgets and plenty of finger-pointing. Manzil Homes is a design-and-build company, so one team owns the whole journey from plot to housewarming.

Our founder, Shaik Miza Mehroz, is a Civil Engineer with an M.Tech in Structures. That engineering background means the luxury you see is backed by sound structure you don't see.

What villa construction includes

  • Site study, Vastu-aligned planning and architectural design
  • Structural design and approvals support
  • Detailed BOQ with transparent, tracked variations
  • Civil construction with site supervision and quality checks
  • Elevation, landscaping and outdoor living areas
  • Complete interiors so the villa is move-in ready
WhatsApp Us +91 94920 54954

Built for the local climate

Coastal Andhra brings salt air and heavy monsoon rain; Telangana brings intense summer heat. We plan orientation, shading, waterproofing and ventilation for the site you have, and choose finishes and fittings that age well in these conditions.

Villas are planned with Vastu from the first sketch, so entrances, kitchens, pooja rooms and master bedrooms sit in the right zones without compromising on light or flow.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can you handle both construction and interiors?

Yes. We are a design-and-build company, so architecture, construction and interiors are delivered by one team under one plan.

How do you keep costs transparent?

You get a detailed bill of quantities before work starts, and any change is documented and tracked so you always know where the budget stands.

Do you build villas outside Visakhapatnam?

Yes. We take on villa projects across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana. Talk to us about your plot and location.
